title: 캐나다 MB 산불 연기 대서양 횡단 유럽 도달 — CAMS/TROPOMI/OMPS/EarthCare 확인
snippet: CAMS (Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service) confirmed the first smoke plume from Manitoba wildfires crossing the Atlantic Ocean and reaching the Mediterranean/Greece on May 18-19, 2026, at approximately 9,000m altitude. Observations by TROPOMI (Sentinel-5P), OMPS (Suomi-NPP), and EarthCare (ESA/JAXA) confirm transatlantic smoke transport. Total Canadian fire emissions now 56 megatonnes carbon — 2nd highest on record for this date. Pyrocumulonimbus (pyroCb) events observed injecting smoke into upper troposphere/lower stratosphere. This is a significant update to the ongoing Canadian wildfire event — transatlantic aerosol transport represents a cross-domain impact (disaster/wildfire + climate/air_pollution).
tag_reason: 신규 업데이트: 캐나다 산불 연기 대서양 횡단 유럽(지중해/그리스) 도달 CAMS 공식 확인. 이전까지는 북미 대륙 내 연기 확산만 보도됨. 다중위성 확인(TROPOMI + OMPS + EarthCare). 56 메가톤 탄소 배출 — 역대 2위. PyrocumulonimbUS 관측. 기존 캐나다 산불 이벤트에 대기오염·기후 교차도메인 업데이트.

confidence_factors.notes: CAMS (Copernicus official) = officialBoost. 3 independent satellites (TROPOMI + OMPS + EarthCare) = multiSatBoost. Cap at 0.92 due to modeled transport (not direct optical imagery of smoke over Europe).
